text: This is your electricity bill. You were supposed to pay it.
formula: thickness(n) = 0.1 mm x 2^n (80 gsm office paper is ~0.1 mm thick); n=0 -> 0.1 mm

text: Instead, you fold it in half. Seven times.
Ten folds. Taller than your coffee mug.
formula: 0.1 mm x 2^10 = 102.4 mm = 10.2 cm (a standard mug is ~9.5 cm tall)

text: Twelve. In real life, that took a kilometre of toilet paper.
formula: 0.1 mm x 2^12 = 409.6 mm = 41 cm. Britney Gallivan's 12 folds (2002) used ~1.2 km (4,000 ft) of toilet paper

text: Fourteen. It's as tall as you are. Mittens is not impressed.
Seventeen. Through the ceiling. The neighbours upstairs have questions.
formula: 0.1 mm x 2^17 = 13,107 mm = 13.1 m (kitchen ceiling ~2.2 m above the table -> passed at fold 15 = 3.3 m)

text: Twenty. A hundred metres. Someone's already selling T-shirts.
Twenty-three. Taller than the Burj Khalifa. This is your fault.
formula: 0.1 mm x 2^23 = 838.9 m > Burj Khalifa 828 m

text: Twenty-seven. Thirteen kilometres. Planes have to go around it.
Thirty folds. Your electricity bill is now in space.
formula: 0.1 mm x 2^30 = 107.37 km > Karman line 100 km

text: Thirty-seven. It's taller than the whole Earth is wide.
formula: 0.1 mm x 2^37 = 13,744 km > Earth's diameter 12,742 km

text: Forty-two. It just went past the Moon.
formula: 0.1 mm x 2^42 = 439,805 km > average Earth-Moon distance 384,400 km

text: Fifty-one folds. It goes past the Sun.
formula: 0.1 mm x 2^51 = 2.2518e8 km = 225 million km > Earth-Sun distance 149.6 million km

text: And no. You still have to pay it.
Keep going to a hundred and three folds, and it's thicker than the observable universe.
formula: 0.1 mm x 2^103 = 1.014e27 m = 107 billion light-years > observable universe diameter ~93 billion ly (8.8e26 m)
